option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific type of reactive arthritis following COVID-19, which is not directly equivalent to Psoriatic Arthritis.
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease, distinct from Psoriatic Arthritis, which is an inflammatory arthritis.

Reactive arthritis is a general term for arthritis triggered by an infection elsewhere in the body. While Psoriatic Arthritis is inflammatory, it is not typically classified as a reactive arthritis in the same way as post-infectious arthritis.
Post-COVID-19 syndrome with osteoarticular and neurological manifestations describes a constellation of symptoms following COVID-19, which is not equivalent to Psoriatic Arthritis.
